[LTIM.10.9] **The engine refuses a malformed `TimeZoneOffset` fact.** The
engine must refuse a host assert of a `TimeZoneOffset` fact with `DS_ERR_INVAL`,
and assert nothing, when:

- its `valid_from` is not before its `valid_until`;
- its `offset_s` is below -64800 or above 64800, eighteen hours either way;
- its `zone` is `"UTC"`, which no fact resolves ([LTIM.10.8]).

A fact whose period overlaps another fact of its zone is admitted, and
[LTIM.10.7] decides which answers. No rule asserts a `TimeZoneOffset` fact
([LSCP.2.5.1]), and no `initial` block holds one ([LGRA.24.2]).
